period.annotatorsHint: Answered counts pairs first answered in this period; Changed counts pairs whose answer was changed in it. Answers, time, agreement and adjudicated also count only this period. Opened and Not opened show what is waiting now. A pair's time counts on the day it was answered.
period.overviewHint: Given out, Answered, Final answers, Couldn't answer, Data problems reported, Agreed, Agreement, Adjudicated and How disputes were settled count only this period (a pair counts as agreed on the day its second answer came in). Opened, Not opened, Waiting for 2nd annotator, Waiting for adjudication, Being adjudicated and the batch table show how things stand now.
period.annotatorHint: Showing the pairs first answered, or changed, in this period. Choose “All time” to see unfinished pairs and move them.

col.answeredTip: Pairs answered out of those given, and how many with each option (their own latest answer per pair; a changed answer counts once).
col.changedTip: Pairs where this person later changed their own answer. Saving the same answer again, or only reporting a problem, is not a change. With a time period, counts pairs changed in it.
col.waitingTip: Pairs given to this person that are not answered yet: opened ones, and ones never opened. Always shows how things stand now, whatever time period is chosen.
col.totalTimeTip: Time spent working on pairs, annotating and adjudicating: counted only while a pair is on screen and in use. Leaving the tab or 2.5 minutes without any activity pauses it.
col.perPairTip: Average working time per answered pair, including any return visits.
col.agreementTip: Of the pairs this person and their partner both answered, how many they answered the same. Low agreement can mean the person needs help, or that the pairs were hard.
col.adjudicatedTip: Disputed pairs this person settled as adjudicator.
col.adjudicationTimeTip: Time spent on the pairs this person adjudicated. It is already part of Total time; Per pair does not include it.
col.perAdjudicationTip: Average working time per pair this person settled as adjudicator, including any return visits. Separate from Per pair, which counts annotation only.
col.disputedTip: Of the pairs this person and their partner both answered, how many went to adjudication: they gave different answers, or one of them chose Can't answer.
col.upheldTip: Of their pairs an adjudicator has settled with an answer, how many ended with this person's answer. Includes disputes, final checks of pairs both annotators answered alike, and pairs where this person chose Can't answer (never upheld). The rest are overruled: click the number to see them. Pairs still waiting, and pairs the adjudicator could not answer either, are not counted.
col.notesTip: Answered pairs where this person left a note. Open the person to read them.
col.finalAnswersTip: Pairs this person settled as adjudicator, and the final answer they gave each.
